disclaimer: This is a planning estimate. Actual prices depend on the city and the facility.

scenarios.name: In-home care (hired aide)
scenarios.note: This one is built from your own numbers: the hourly rate and the hours you entered (defaults: $30/hour, 20 hours a week). Monthly cost = hours per week × 52 / 12 × rate, rounded down to the cent. For comparison, CareScout's 2025 median for a non-medical caregiver is $35/hour.

scenarios.name: Assisted living
scenarios.note: The national median for 2025, published 03/02/2026. It's a planning figure, not official statistics, and your area may be higher or lower.

scenarios.name: Memory care
scenarios.note: Needs verification: the CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2025 has no memory care figure. This value comes from a marketing report by a company that refers families to facilities, and the report page could not be found as of 11/14/2026. Hidden by default for that reason.

scenarios.name: Nursing home, private room
scenarios.note: The national median for 2025: $355 per day, $129,575 per year. Monthly: 129,575 / 12 = $10,797.91 (rounded down to the cent). A planning figure, not official statistics.
